name: my-04--kimi-k3-1-pro
question: What service tax rate applies to food and beverage services in Malaysia?
answer:
The service tax rate for taxable **food and beverage (F&B) services in Malaysia is 6%**.

F&B services were excluded from the increase to 8% that applied to many other taxable services from **1 March 2024**. The 6% tax is charged by service-tax-registered F&B operators on taxable services, so it does not automatically apply to every restaurant or food purchase.

Any separate **service charge** imposed by an establishment is different from service tax.
